scope_boundary: This chapter covers Part III of the Constitution of India (Articles 12 to 35) including all fundamental rights, their features, definitions, exceptions, judicial interpretations, and related amendments up to the 103rd Amendment Act of 2019. Constitutional amendments enacted after 2019, detailed provisions of other parts of the Constitution (except Article 300A and Part XIII mentioned briefly), and comparative constitutional law of other countries (beyond limited references to USA and UK) are out of scope.
